scope: bounded paired protected-mode read-modify-write access-rights and writable control

observations.read_only_ds: The authored 32-bit INC dword access through read-only DS entered QEMU #GP(0) with fault EIP at INC, unchanged backing and general registers, and pushed EFLAGS matching the seeded pre-state except the QEMU RF bit. The handler loaded writable DS and retried once to completion. Frozen DOSBox-X instead completed the increment with DS=0x20, no handler marker and updated backing. This is a reference divergence, not paired parity.
observations.writable_control: With writable DS, both engines completed the same INC without a fault; 0x7fffffff became 0x80000000, CF remained set, OF/SF/AF/PF set, and ZF/IF cleared.
observations.test_harness: Initial native attempts exposed only harness issues: API register naming, a missing DOSBox memory-read closure, reading handler-written fields before handler execution, and comparing live EAX after the fixture used AX to record DS. These were corrected before the accepted two-case run; no QEMU source change was made.
